keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «볼트는 시키는 대로 정확히 그대로만 했다(문제)» 와 «유나가 분명하고 꼼꼼하게 지시했다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Bolt did exactly what people told him) and the solution (Yuna gave clear and careful instructions). The green sentences are the answers.

words that tell you what to do
he washed the clean ones in the cupboard, too.

qs.q: Why did the cat cry at the door?
opts: Bolt left it outside in the hard rain.
evs: One morning, Yuna said, "Bolt, please wash the dishes."
Bolt put the cat outside, even when it started to rain hard.
From then on, Yuna gave Bolt clear and careful instructions.
Dad bought a robot helper named Bolt to help with the housework.
why: 볼트는 비가 세차게 내리기 시작해도 고양이를 밖에 그대로 두었어요. 그래서 고양이가 젖고 추웠어요. 배고팠다거나 유나가 화를 냈다는 말은 없어요.
Bolt kept the cat outside even when it started to rain hard, so it was wet and cold. Nothing says it was hungry or that Yuna was angry.

qs.q: Yuna says, "Bolt, you have to think about what I really mean!" What does she want Bolt to do?
qs.qko: 유나가 "Bolt, you have to think about what I really mean!"이라고 해요. 볼트가 무엇을 하기를 바라나요?
opts: understand the reason behind her words
say her words again and again
evs: Later, Yuna said, "Put the cat outside," because it was a sunny day.
Dad bought a robot helper named Bolt to help with the housework.
The poor cat cried at the door, all wet and cold.
One morning, Yuna said, "Bolt, please wash the dishes."
why: 유나는 «날씨가 맑아서» 고양이를 내보내라고 했어요. 그 이유까지 생각했다면 비가 올 때 고양이를 들여보냈을 거예요.
Yuna asked to put the cat outside «because it was a sunny day». If Bolt thought about that reason, he would bring the cat in when it rained.

qs.q: Why did Bolt wash the clean dishes, too?
opts: He followed Yuna's words exactly, without thinking.
The clean dishes were very dirty.
Dad told him to wash every dish.
evs: Bolt did exactly what people told him to do.
The poor cat cried at the door, all wet and cold.
One morning, Yuna said, "Bolt, please wash the dishes."
Dad bought a robot helper named Bolt to help with the housework.
why: 볼트는 시키는 대로 정확히 그대로 했고, 유나는 그냥 «설거지 좀 해 줘» 라고만 말했어요. 그래서 깨끗한 그릇까지 씻었어요.
Bolt did exactly what people told him, and Yuna only said «please wash the dishes». So he washed the clean ones, too.

ends: Bolt learns to ask, "What do you really mean?"
볼트가 «진짜 무슨 뜻이에요?» 하고 묻는 법을 배워요.
Dad gives Bolt a new job in the garden.

write.src: “It is important to <u>give clear instructions</u> because <u>words can mean different things</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write an important thing to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «It is important to» 뒤에는 동사(wash, listen)를 바로 쓰고, «because» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «It is important to», write a verb (wash, listen). After «because», write who + what.
